mgmt_bio.text: An entrepreneur with more than four decades in the electronics industry, he founded motherboard maker Young Micro Systems in 1988, PC-chipset IC design company ITE Tech in 1995 and ADSL chip designer ITeX in 1997; Young Micro Systems merged with Foxconn in 1994 and ITeX listed on NASDAQ in 2001. He joined Foxconn in 2007 as Special Assistant to the Founder, became general manager of the Innovation Digital System Business Group in 2010, chairman of Socle Technology in 2014, and founded and led the Semiconductor Business Group in 2016.

At board level, an independent director and an institutional director resigned in June and July 2026, and Hsu Tzu-Mei joined the Remuneration and Corporate Governance and Nomination committees on August 12, 2026.

mgmt_team_view.text: Public reporting notes that Liu Young-Way has been chairman and chief executive since 2019, succeeding founder Terry Gou in the first separation of ownership from professional management at the top of the company, and has framed strategy around the "3+3" shift into electric vehicles, digital health and robotics, supported by AI, semiconductors and next-generation communications. Fiscal 2025 brought record net profit of NT$189.3 billion and EPS of NT$13.61, with ROE of 11.25%, alongside a reported share above 40% of the global AI server market. On capital allocation and disclosure, the group states a target average cash payout ratio of at least 40% and declared NT$7.2 per share for 2025, a 52.9% payout and the seventh straight year above 50%.

sentences.text: Hon Hai Precision Industry (Foxconn) is levered to AI infrastructure spending: third-quarter 2026 revenue hit a record NT$3.03 trillion, up 47% year on year, on AI server and smart consumer electronics demand.

thesis_pillars.text: Hon Hai Precision Industry (Foxconn) is levered to AI infrastructure spending: third-quarter 2026 revenue hit a record NT$3.03 trillion, up 47% year on year, on AI server and smart consumer electronics demand. Its business mix has structurally shifted, as cloud and networking reached nearly 50% of first-quarter 2026 revenue and AI servers passed 50% of total server revenue for the first time. Margins are improving alongside scale: second-quarter 2026 operating profit rose 68% to NT$94.8 billion on a 3.75% operating margin. Management guides for continued growth, with full-year AI server rack shipments projected to more than double. Legacy consumer electronics still contribute, with new iPhone shipments boosting assembly results. Key risk: Foxconn has flagged a volatile global political and economic environment.
